case.name: Run Merchant Batches
case.description: Runs the client's Square reconciliation batches and arms the recurring Square auto-schedule, or no-ops for Stripe.

steps.name: Run and schedule the merchant reconciliation batches
steps.description: AUTOMATED (T6). Branches on the {{merchantType}} operator input. For SQUARE it reproduces the manual 'Veevart Settings > Merchant Account > Square Batches' + 'Batches > Automatic Schedule > Square > Save' playbook from anonymous Apex: (1) persists Auctifera__Schedule_Square__c = true on the Auctifera__Batch_Settings__c org default (the 'Square' checkbox), (2) calls the GLOBAL Auctifera.AutomaticBatchSchedule.execute(null) — the exact method the Save button runs — which schedules the recurring Square jobs idempotently (each schedule is internally guarded by an existing-job-name check; the call is also wrapped to tolerate an 'already scheduled' race so re-running the IC never hard-fails), (3) arms the daily meta-scheduler cron (Veevart - Automatic Batch Schedule) if absent so the schedule self-heals, and (4) runs an immediate first reconciliation pass for the two named batches via Database.executeBatch. It then VERIFIES (throws => step FAILED) the durable flag is true, the REQUIRED CronTriggers exist (Veevart - Square charge fix + Veevart - Square refund status update + the daily meta-scheduler), and both immediate AsyncApexJob rows are in an accepted state. The Veevart - Square payment synchronization job is also scheduled by execute() but is checked as INFORMATIONAL only (managed-package behavior that can vary by Auctifera version / payment config), so it never causes a false failure. For STRIPE it is a verified no-op success-with-note (no IE-run Square batches; Stripe propagation runs via the always-on managed Stripe batches). This replaces the previous manual handoff: the v1 author had assumed scheduling needed the non-global SquareSchedulable (actually the unrelated Square token-refresher), but the UI Save path uses the GLOBAL AutomaticBatchSchedule, which IS callable cross-namespace (proven, re-run idempotent, on CamiloDevOrg). Class/field/job names are Auctifera managed-package constants — identical in every Veevart client org, not org-specific values. Verifies ENQUEUE/SCHEDULE, not async batch COMPLETION.

requiredInputs.label: Payment merchant
requiredInputs.description: The client's payment merchant. SQUARE runs the two Square reconciliation batches and arms the recurring Square auto-schedule. STRIPE is a no-op success (Stripe has no IE-run reconciliation batches — propagation is handled by the always-on managed Stripe batches).

template.name: IC 9.1: Run Merchant Batches
template.description: Single-case template for 9.1 (AUTO: one AUTOMATED T6 step that branches on {{merchantType}} — for SQUARE it persists Auctifera__Schedule_Square__c, schedules the Square recurring jobs via the global Auctifera.AutomaticBatchSchedule.execute (re-run idempotent), arms the daily meta-scheduler, runs an immediate pass, and verifies flag + required crons + AsyncApexJob with payment-sync informational; for STRIPE it is a verified no-op). Fully automated — the v1 manual auto-schedule handoff was removed once AutomaticBatchSchedule was confirmed global. v4 fixes the Stripe-path verify to snapshot pre-existing Square AsyncApexJob Ids and assert no NEW Square rows (delta), so a Square→Stripe re-run no longer false-fails on leftover or cron-fired jobs. Runs standalone with dependsOn [].
